dashboard.label: TA-cronbeat Overview
dashboard.description: Collects scheduled-job heartbeat data: all systemd timers (next elapsed, last elapsed, last-run timestamps) via systemctl list-timers, plus a count of cron jobs from /etc/crontab

search.query: index=main sourcetype="cronbeat:status" | stats latest(_time) as "Last seen", count as Reports by host | table host "Last seen" Reports
| mcatalog values(metric_name) as m where index=metrics metric_name="cronbeat.*" | eval count=mvcount(m)
index=main sourcetype="cronbeat:status" _raw="*alarm*" | sort - _time | table _time host _raw | rename _raw as Event | head 200
